note: Similarity-method rows: best achievable F1 over the threshold sweep, plus F1 at the shipped threshold. The "guard:" row reuses those two fields for different quantities, because the ratchet compares them the same way: bestF1 is the share of 48 reversed decisions the guard catches (must not fall), and shippedF1 is MINUS the share of 48 restatements it wrongly blocks, negated so a rise in false blocks also reads as a drop.
